# Economy rebalance: build kit for the repo chat (Claude Code on cute-games/cozy-town)

Approved by Karolis 30 Oct 2026 ("do the rebalance"). Book entries eco-rt-01 ... eco-rt-10 (chapter Schedules and economy; the bug in Bugs and fixes).
Made by the Schedules and economy chat, which has no push access. Base: main a47bb1a (stamp 2026102902). Patch: kits/economy-rebalance.patch (2 commits, git format-patch).

## What it changes (js only + COZY_BUILD 2026103101)
- js/03-game.js: lvPay(lv)=2*lv + 100 at every 10th level (was 10*lv) in addXP and bumpLevel; bumpLevel keeps XP toward the next level (was reset to 0: bug); Sports speed boost 1+min(lv-1,10)*0.03 (cap +30%, unchanged up to level 11); litter Cleaning XP 2 -> 5; quests Flower power 40 -> 50, New look 40 -> 80.
- js/02-world.js: school board "Learn something new" only 8:00-20:00 (isDaytime) with a closed toast; HS_PAY 1 star 15 -> 30.
- js/07-designer.js: DS_PAY 20/50/90/130 -> 40/70/100/140; TC_PAY 15+60s -> 30+60s (90/150/210); claw: level prize via bumpLevel(k,1,true) (no coins); max 10 prizes a game day (S.clawDay=[day,n], clawEmpty() toast from Mr. Toby).
- js/09-mainloop.js: PT_PAY 1 star 15 -> 30; dance-off pays 15 only for the first 3 rounds a game day (S.dance.pd/pn), result card says so.
Saves: only adds optional fields (S.clawDay, S.dance.pd/pn); old saves load (kit B1 PASS).

## Checks already run in the economy chat (kit v7, joined file, offline)
Quick kit (--only files,counts,saves,night3,run4) on the patched file: 40 PASS, 1 FAIL (N8).
N8 fails the same way on today's main (baseline run): the fixture save-prepet1-designer2.json is missing from cozy-check-v7.zip ("no saved 2-room order"). Not caused by the patch.
First run found N37 (Tree park hard jumps) broken by a stricter speed cap; fixed in commit 2 and N37 passes.
NOT run: full check, two-player, real devices (needs the repo chat).

## Steps for the repo chat
1. git checkout -b claude/economy-rebalance origin/main; backup branch backup-YYYY-MM-DD from main.
2. Get the patch: ArtifactData get collection kits doc economy-rebalance (field patch) on https://claude.ai/artifact/6VamW3iTDycZZjZnfTrZa3; save it to a file -> git am it. If main moved, rebase; COZY_BUILD must stay bigger than live.
3. Join -> full kit v7 -> paste output; fix N8 fixture if possible (or list as NOT VERIFIED).
4. Open the pull request; Karolis merges. After merge: Live log entry, entries eco-rt-* -> live, Town Timetable data refresh (claude/economy-kit.md).
